title: 7-Day Willpower Rebuild
description: Willpower is a finite budget. This program teaches you to spend it wisely and rebuild your willpower reserves.
outcomes: Conserve willpower by designing your environment
Build willpower through small, consistent actions

days.title: The Willpower Budget
days.insight: Willpower is like money — once it's gone, it's gone. You need to budget it carefully.
days.action: Identify your three most important willpower decisions today. Make them early when your willpower is fresh.
days.reflectionQuestion: Where do I waste the most willpower?

days.title: Environment Design
days.insight: Good habits happen automatically. Bad habits require willpower. Design your environment for success.
days.action: Remove one friction point from your day. Make the right choice the easy choice.
days.reflectionQuestion: What friction is draining my willpower?

days.title: The 10-Minute Rule
days.insight: When you feel like giving up, wait 10 minutes. Willpower is not constant — it fluctuates.
days.action: When you feel like quitting, wait 10 minutes. If you still want to quit after 10 minutes, then quit.
days.reflectionQuestion: What would happen if I waited 10 minutes?

days.title: Habit Stacking
days.insight: Habits run automatically, saving your willpower for when it really matters.
days.action: Attach one new habit to an existing habit. 'After my morning coffee, I will meditate for 2 minutes.'
days.reflectionQuestion: What habit can I stack onto an existing one?

days.title: The Decision Freeze
days.insight: Every decision drains willpower. Reduce decisions to conserve willpower for what matters.
days.action: Choose 3 decisions to make today at the start. No new decisions after 5 PM.
days.reflectionQuestion: What decisions can I make now and never think about again?

days.title: Willpower Recovery
days.insight: Willpower depletes throughout the day. You need to recover it regularly.
days.action: Schedule 3 willpower recovery breaks today — each 15 minutes. No decisions, no tasks. Just rest.
days.reflectionQuestion: When do I typically run out of willpower?

days.title: The Willpower Reset
days.insight: At the end of the week, review your willpower budget. What worked? What drained you?
days.action: Write down your willpower wins from this week. Plan your willpower budget for next week.
days.reflectionQuestion: What will I do differently with my willpower next week?
